commands: set +x; GITHUB_TOKEN=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id esafx/production/github-clone --region $REGION --query SecretString --output text); set -x

git_pull() { local name=$1 branch=$2; set +x; local url="https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/Esa-FX/${name}.git"; git -C "$name" remote set-url origin "$url"; set -x; git -C "$name" fetch origin "$branch"; git -C "$name" checkout "$branch"; git -C "$name" reset --hard "origin/$branch"; git -C "$name" remote set-url origin "https://github.com/Esa-FX/${name}.git"; git -C "$name" log -1 --oneline; }
docker compose -f deploy/production/docker-compose.core.yml --profile migrate run --rm audit-migrate
